lede: Harrison could not finish — the one exception aside — and watched the clock expire on a spike with a field goal sitting there, so a half point is what he got. Jon went the other way: overtime at SoFi, 37-34, eleven points and sole possession of second. And at the top, still, is Mark, who lost two games by a combined 52, started a backup quarterback on Sunday night, won anyway, and ends the week leading by exactly the four points he led by before it. The evil empire does not appear to need a reason.

beats.tag: Jon · Overtime, and second by himself
beats.text: Allen finished with 331 total yards, 121 of them rushing, and Buffalo needed every one. James Cook ran for two scores and then fumbled in overtime at the Rams' 20. Los Angeles drove to the Buffalo 30 and Greg Rousseau blocked the 48-yarder. Allen scrambled 19 and 13, and Tyler Bass won it from 45. Eleven points, clear of Harrison by half.

Fourteen games, fourteen head-to-heads — every one of them puts two owners on opposite sidelines. There is no Thursday gift, no free point hiding in a division game. Cincinnati, Detroit, Miami and Minnesota are on bye, so Bill, Patrick, Zach and Harrison each play the week a team short.

beats.tag: Sunday · Jon at Mark, first against second
beats.text: Buffalo at Las Vegas, 4:25, and it is the only game that moves the top of the table. Jon is on a short week after a Monday night overtime game and stayed out west rather than fly home; he is also down to a thin receiver room, with D.J. Moore's 91-game streak over and Josh Palmer out. Las Vegas has not named a quarterback — Kirk Cousins was benched in Foxborough for Fernando Mendoza, the first pick in the draft.

Washington at San Francisco closes the week. The 49ers are 5-0 and favored by a touchdown and a half; Nick Bosa has missed three games with the calf and may be back. Jayden Daniels returned from the dislocated elbow, ran for 103 and two scores, and still did not win — the clock ran out on Washington's spike. Harrison has to go into Levi's to defend second.

beats.tag: Zach · Five, and it is getting hard to watch
beats.text: The Rams had the ball in overtime at the Buffalo 30 and had a field goal blocked. The Chargers are 0-5 with a receiver room that is mostly injury report. Miami is on bye, which is arguably the best thing that happens to him this week. He gets Arizona at home and Dallas at Green Bay and could still finish the week on five.
